description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Instant Cast 1] and [Buff Earth 10% (15s)]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Instant Cast 1], [Buff Prismatic 20% (15s)] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ Core/Beyond allies are alive, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Awoken Earth] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Buff Earth 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)], [Buff Earth 10% (15s)], [Buff Wind 10% (15s)], [Buff Water 10% (15s)], [Buff Holy 10% (15s)], [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] and [Buff Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Buff Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 20% (15s)], [Buff Ice 20% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)], [Buff Earth 20% (15s)], [Buff Wind 20% (15s)], [Buff Water 20% (15s)], [Buff Holy 20% (15s)], [Buff Dark 20% (15s)] and [Buff Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time
